name: Linear
visual_personality: Linear signature design: dark precision keyboard-first saas, engineered with high-craft aesthetics, structured hierarchy, and platform-native ergonomics.

typography.letter_spacing: -0.025em for display headings, -0.01em for body text

spacing.grid_system: 12-column responsive grid with 24px gutters, max-width 1240px
spacing.whitespace_philosophy: Generous vertical section breathing room paired with dense, high-efficiency component modules.

components.buttons: Subtle rounded 6-8px pills, solid primary accent with white text, or frosted translucent glass with 1px border (#222326).
components.cards: Subtle 1px border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), dark surface, radial hover glow spotlight, no visual clutter.
components.forms: Minimal dark inputs with 1px border (#28282c), focus ring in primary accent with 2px offset.
components.navigation: Sticky frosted pill header (backdrop-blur-md, bg-black/60), minimal logo left, keyboard shortcuts and action CTA right.
components.hero_section: Asymmetric hero with glowing radial gradient spotlight, high-impact headline, interactive app viewport mockup.
components.footer: Structured 4-5 column dark footer with system status indicator dot and keyboard shortcut badge.

motion.scroll_effects: Staggered reveal on view, subtle parallax on device frames, micro-glows on cursor proximity.
motion.micro_interactions: Instant keyboard feedback, active row highlights, smooth modal sheets.

responsive.mobile_strategy: Bottom sheet modals, collapsible sidebars, single column stacked cards, touch-optimized tap targets.
responsive.desktop_strategy: Full keyboard navigation (K-bar/command palette), multi-pane issue columns, split view inspect.

overall_design_dna: Linear design DNA: Large typography, generous whitespace, monochrome palette, subtle borders, restrained motion, asymmetric hero composition and strong product-focused visual hierarchy.
design_principles: Why Linear looks like this: Built to communicate speed, craft, and keyboard-first productivity by removing clutter and focusing on high contrast, micro-details, and crisp dark backgrounds.
implementation_notes: Development Guide: Use Tailwind bg-[#08090a], border-white/10, hover:border-white/20, font-inter with -tracking-[0.02em] and lucide-react icons.

spacing.whitespace_philosophy: Generous vertical section breathing room paired with dense, high-efficiency component modules.

components.buttons: Subtle rounded 6-8px pills, solid primary accent with white text, or frosted translucent glass with 1px border (#222326).
components.cards: Subtle 1px border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), dark surface, radial hover glow spotlight, no visual clutter.
components.forms: Minimal dark inputs with 1px border (#28282c), focus ring in primary accent with 2px offset.

components.footer: Structured 4-5 column dark footer with system status indicator dot and keyboard shortcut badge.

motion.scroll_effects: Staggered reveal on view, subtle parallax on device frames, micro-glows on cursor proximity.
motion.micro_interactions: Instant keyboard feedback, active row highlights, smooth modal sheets.

responsive.mobile_strategy: Bottom sheet modals, collapsible sidebars, single column stacked cards, touch-optimized tap targets.
responsive.desktop_strategy: Full keyboard navigation (K-bar/command palette), multi-pane issue columns, split view inspect.

components.buttons: Terminal-style command buttons with $ prefix and copy feedback icon.

motion.transitions: Instant 100ms-150ms transitions for snappy developer ergonomics

motion.micro_interactions: One-click copy code snippet feedback, command bar keyboard navigation.

responsive.mobile_strategy: Horizontal scrollable code blocks, condensed tree navigation, touch copy action.
responsive.desktop_strategy: Three-column docs layout (sidebar, content, on-this-page TOC) and multi-tab terminal.

overall_design_dna: Supabase design DNA: Terminal windows, syntax highlighting, monospace metadata, hairline borders, and live developer CLI workflows.
design_principles: Why Supabase looks like this: Built for instant technical comprehension, zero latency, and engineering credibility.
implementation_notes: Development Guide: Use Prism/Shiki syntax styling, font-mono, bg-slate-950, and border-slate-800.

typography.scale: Hero: 72-110px, Project Title: 48px, Index Number: 14px, Body: 16px
typography.letter_spacing: -0.04em for mega typography, +0.08em for index mono numbers

spacing.grid_system: Strict editorial baseline grid (columns separated by solid 1px black/white lines)
spacing.whitespace_philosophy: Dramatic contrast between giant typography and sprawling negative space.

components.buttons: Raw geometric rectangle with hard 0px corners, inverted on hover.
components.cards: Full-bleed project showcase cards with hover video autoplay and floating cursor title badge.
components.forms: Single-line minimalist inquiry form with underline border.
components.navigation: Minimalist 4-corner navigation layout or full-screen menu overlay.
components.hero_section: Giant editorial headline filling the viewport, project index ticker, reel video preview.
components.footer: Giant contact email headline (e.g., 'LET'S TALK') spanning 100% viewport width.

motion.transitions: Sharp 300ms easeInOut transitions, image distortion on hover.
motion.scroll_effects: Smooth locomotive inertia scroll, skew on scroll velocity, image curtain reveal.
motion.micro_interactions: Floating image cursor follow, project thumbnail preview on list row hover.

responsive.mobile_strategy: Vertical project list stack, full-screen drawer menu, touch thumbnail tap reveals.
responsive.desktop_strategy: Cursor follower media previews, multi-column editorial index table, split screen project view.

overall_design_dna: Fantasy design DNA: Giant editorial display typography, raw 0px brutalist grids, project index table view, and floating media cursor previews.
design_principles: Why Fantasy looks like this: Engineered to establish creative authority, cultural relevance, and fearless artistic vision.
implementation_notes: Development Guide: Use font-serif or font-sans with -tracking-[0.04em], border-b table dividers, and smooth scroll.
